aiBuildDescription: Describe the form in plain language and the AI will suggest fields. Nothing is added until you review and pick them.
aiDescription: Lets AI work on this form's submissions (spam re-scoring, digest, form help, reply drafts). Off by default — nothing is sent to any model provider while it is off. When on, submission content (names, email addresses and message text) is sent to your AI provider and processed under that provider's data-processing terms.
aiPromptPlaceholder: e.g. A contact form with name, email, and a message, plus a dropdown for the reason they are writing
aiProviderByok: Your AI provider is your own saved key (BYOK) — see AI settings to change it.
aiProviderPlatform: Your AI provider is the platform key — see AI settings to change it.
confirmDelete: Delete "{name}"? This also deletes its {submissions} submission(s). This cannot be undone.
confirmUnlink: Unlink {domain}? Submissions from it will be rejected.
deleteFormDescription: Permanently deletes this form, its fields, domain links and {submissions} submission(s). This cannot be undone.
description: Contact forms that collect submissions from your verified domains
descriptionPlaceholder: Shown in the dashboard only — visitors never see it.
detailDescription: Form settings, fields, allowed domains and notifications
digestDescription: Email a regular summary of this form's new submissions. Independent of AI — with AI off, a plain list is sent instead.
domainsDescription: This form only accepts submissions from the verified domains linked here. One form can serve many domains; one domain can serve many forms.
embedDescription: Paste this where the form should appear. The SDK enhances the form automatically — no JavaScript of your own is needed. Submissions are only accepted from your linked verified domains.
embedNoDomainWarning: This form has no linked domain yet — link a verified domain before embedding, or submissions will be rejected.
embedPausedWarning: This form is paused and is not accepting submissions.
embedPlainSuffix: works too — see the SDK docs.
embedTurnstileKeyMissing: Turnstile is turned on for this form, but no site key is configured (NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY). Set the site key in the dashboard environment — until then every submission will be rejected, so no embed snippet is shown.
emptyDescription: Create your first form to start collecting submissions from your sites. Every form starts with name, email and message fields.
fieldKeyHint: The key in the submission payload. It cannot be changed later.
fieldsDescription: The fields visitors fill in. The key is what arrives in the submission payload.
honeypotDescription: An invisible field bots fill in and humans never see.
newDescription: Create a contact form for your sites
newFormNote: The form starts with name, email and message fields — you can add, edit or remove fields afterwards.
noDomainsLinked: No domains linked yet. Link a verified domain below — until then this form accepts submissions from nowhere.
noFields: No fields yet — add one below.
noLinkablePrefix: No verified domains available to link. Verify a domain first from
notificationsDescription: Each new submission is emailed to these addresses. One row per recipient — toggling one never touches the others.
publicUserIdDescription: Your public identifier — used with the form ID by the SDK and REST API.
redirectHint: After a successful submission the visitor is sent here instead of seeing the success message.
resendConfirmationFailed: Could not resend the confirmation email.
settingsDescription: Name, messages, redirect and spam protection for this form
statusFailed: Could not change the form status.
successMessagePlaceholder: Thanks! We'll get back to you soon.
testEmailFailed: Could not send the test email.
title: Forms
turnstileDescription: Extra bot protection on the submission form.
turnstileServerMissing: Turnstile is on, but bot protection is not configured on this server (TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY is unset). Every submission to this form will be rejected until the server is configured — turn Turnstile off, or set the secret on the API server.
